messages:
Jordan (Product): Announcing GA for the new Hosted API endpoint: /v1/realtime-toolbridge — enables combined streaming + tool orchestration for multi-tool workflows. Rolling this out today at 11:00 PT. Docs: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/realtime-toolbridge :tada:

Lena (DevEx): Nice. Will there be SDK helpers for composing tool graphs and parsing interleaved stream events?

Jordan (Product): Yes — SDK v1.3.0 includes `ToolBridge` builder + a stream iterator that yields either model delta frames or tool invocation events. Examples in the quickstart.

Mike (Eng): Rollout plan: canary 8% for 20m, 25% for 40m, 100% after smoke. No forced migration — but note: older `/v1/stream-tool` will be deprecated in 45 days. We'll auto-map trivial cases for 2 weeks to ease migration.

Pri (SRE): I'll add dashboards for combined stream/event latency and tool-backend error saturation. PD rule if tool-backend errors > 2% for 10m. Also enabling detailed request traces for the first 24h.

Clara (Legal): Quick flag: if tool payloads include sensitive identifiers, we must ensure they respect the hosted redaction policy; Dedicated/Private defaults are unchanged. I'll post a compliance note.

Jordan (Product): Agreed. Hosted will include a soft-redaction warning by default and opt-in strict-redaction. Dedicated/Private continue to default to strict. Well include this in the migration checklist.

deploy-bot: started canary deployment: realtime-toolbridge v1 @8% (deploy_id: dpl_2026_11_02_1893000000)

changelog-bot: Draft release note queued: "Hosted: /v1/realtime-toolbridge GA — multi-tool streaming + orchestration; 45-day deprecation for /v1/stream-tool."

Lena (DevEx): Quick curl example Ill add to the quickstart:
```bash
curl -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime-toolbridge \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-pro","workflow":[{"tool":"search","schema":{"q":"string"}},{"tool":"summarize","schema":{"length":"int"}}],"input":"summarize latest docs"}'
```

Mike (Eng): If any validator regressions happen, ping me and Ill cut the rollback. Hotfix branch is ready.

Pri (SRE): Canary health after 20m: OK. No elevated error rates. Tracing shows expected tool-call latencies.

Jordan (Product): Customer-facing blurb for release-notes channel: "New: Realtime ToolBridge (GA) — combine streaming generation with structured multi-tool orchestration. Migration: /v1/stream-tool will be deprecated in 45 days; SDKs and migration tools provided." Ill post once canary finishes.

Lena (DevEx): Ill follow up with sample notebooks and a migration script that bulk-updates simple single-tool calls.

Jordan (Product): Thanks team. Pinning the migration checklist in this thread and scheduling 30d/7d reminders.
